messages.author: 35651167c032511e
messages.subject: 0.4.0 file upload not working (for me)
parts:
Hi there,

very enthusiastically I just upgraded to 0.4.0, and then file upload in my application didn't work any more. This is the relevant piece of code:

-----------------------------------------------------------------
  values <- reactiveValues()

  output$loadData <- reactive({
    if (is.null(input$upload)) {
        # User has not uploaded a file yet
        return(NULL)
      }

    fileInfo <- input$upload
    tmpDir <- tempfile()
    unzip(fileInfo$datapath, exdir=tmpDir)

    values$spectra <- getMqSpectra(tmpDir)
  })
-----------------------------------------------------------------

I upload a .zip of a directory structure (full of mass spectra), unzip it in a temporary space and load it with routines suited for this file format.

However, after switching to 0.4.0, just _nothing_ happens. Neither do I get my uploaded file, nor any error message. My Browser is Firefox 19.

Anything known about this yet?

Otherwise: GREAT WORK!!! Previous to finding Shiny, I wrote GUIs for my software prototypes using Tk. But Shiny so much easier to write, and my users are absolutely excited about the look and feel w/ Shiny. Thx a lot for this package!

Regards
Christoph

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: 0.4.0 file upload not working (for me)
parts:
Shiny now assumes that outputs that aren't actually visible don't need to be run. I'm guessing there isn't actually an output named loadData in your UI.

Observers are designed for cases like this (learn more on this new page on reactivity). Does it help if you change the first line like so?

observe({

if (is.null(input$upload)) {
        # User has not uploaded a file yet
        return(NULL)
      }

    fileInfo <- input$upload
    tmpDir <- tempfile()
    unzip(fileInfo$datapath, exdir=tmpDir)

    values$spectra <- getMqSpectra(tmpDir)
  })
